LOW.why: At 0.55 the observed error is 3.7%, within the 10% tolerance.

MEDIUM.why: No threshold down to 0.50 kept the error within 5%. Nothing in this class may execute without a human.

HIGH.why: No threshold down to 0.50 kept the error within 1%. Nothing in this class may execute without a human.

note: Calibrated against the transition constraint only. The running gate also intersects with actor rank and posting scope, which raises confidence further, so these are a floor to start from rather than a guarantee. MEDIUM-risk actions are ANTI-calibrated on this data: error rises from 18.8% to 27.2% as confidence goes from 0.80 to 0.90, so a higher bar admits worse decisions. Only LOW-risk actions may be automated.
